scope: Accelerate only production lexical256 candidate geometry; frozen H2bc and every scientific policy remain untouched. Exact candidate tuples, ordering, logical metadata, move choices, traces, boards, counters and flags required. No new scientific samples.
algorithm: Reuse unchanged selected-free global-degree1/2 raw chain decomposition. One selected-graph DFS records connected components, bridges and subtree endpoint membership. A bridge chain on the endpoint path is vetoed; a closed selected chain or nonbridge two-anchor chain decreases cycle rank by exactly one. All other chains preserve rank. Preserve old logical reachability-check count as number of predicates, separately disclose actual graph traversals. No scoring, native-descent, candidate-limit or terminal-rule changes.

geometry_cohort.eligible_states: Every active lexical256 geometry state in immutable archived trace order, including no-candidate states and initial/final terminal enumerations. Exclude veto-only states because that production function is unchanged.
geometry_cohort.selection: Deduplicate exact (tokens, selected board) bytes. Select the1024 unique states with smallest SHA256 over a fixed domain separator H2bd-geometry-v1 followed by tokens and board canonical contiguous uint8 bytes. Ties resolved by token then board bytes. Source identity retained; no runtime information used. Freeze selected keys/hashes before benchmark.
geometry_cohort.unit: One complete legacy or accelerated candidates(tokens, board) call, including raw-chain extraction, all connectivity/cycle predicates and returned metadata construction.

correctness_gates.synthetic: Exhaust 3^7=2187 free-unselected/free-selected/wall assignments on3x3 with opposite-corner endpoints, plus all30 ordered endpoint pairs on2x3 with remaining four cells in three states (2430). Add96 rectangular random fixtures:32 each of shapes(5,7),(7,5),(11,13), SeedSequence([20261115,2,64,shape_index,fixture_index]), opposite-corner fixed endpoints, remaining cells wall with probability.2 then nonwall selected with probability.65. Add12 exact chain boundaries: for L in255,256,257,511,512,513, one selected1x(L+2) endpoint-to-endpoint bridge path and one selected3x(L+2) perimeter cycle with top-corner endpoints/interior walls; assert top free-chain size L and every returned size/oversize count. Exhaustive cases include dangling/off-endpoint bridges, disconnected endpoints, cycles and repeated-anchor incidence. Allclamped endpointselected.
correctness_gates.archived: Compare every active cycle geometry and initial/final terminal enumeration from all H2ay and H2bc archived traces, including candidate tuples and complete logical metadata; retained old independent NumPy geometry also verifies selected fixtures.
correctness_gates.complete_policy: Before benchmark freeze, optimized unified48 replays fixed H2bc shard00 across all three models, against every archived full-policy state/choice/trace/flag and original objective certificate. No speed endpoint estimated in gate.

geometry_benchmark.worker_cpu: Work CPU0 pinned, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1; inputs preloaded, both implementations run one identical32-state warmup outside timed region.
geometry_benchmark.clock: process_time for complete fixed1024-state sweep, including all geometry and output construction. Record perf_counter separately; no compilation in purePython implementation.
geometry_benchmark.target: Median paired legacy_process_seconds / fast_process_seconds >=2.0; exact full outputs each repetition required.

complete_policy_benchmark.cohort: All256 fresh H2bc shard00 mazes, all3 fixed models; source reuse now. No outcome exclusions or replacement. Tokens/readouts not supplied from archives: include fresh hidden settling on each timed replay.
complete_policy_benchmark.gpu_schedule: GPU0 repetitions0,1 (legacy-fast then fast-legacy); GPU1 repetitions2,3 (fast-legacy then legacy-fast). Every repetition includes all256 inputs and all3models on one fixed GPU; compare pairs only within that GPU.
complete_policy_benchmark.model_loading: Load fixed old LP float32 and promoted float64 models once perworker outside timed region, report separately. Both implementations receive identical first32 cohort inputs/all3models warmup once perworker, outside timing but inside fixed worker wall budget. No JIT/compile.
complete_policy_benchmark.timed_scope: CPU tokens through device transfer, shared float32 hidden solve/readout, binary native prefix, veto16, corrected unified16, up to32 extra lexical rounds, all native suffixes, original-margin eligibility and initial/final terminal checks, and CPU-returned final boards/iterations/flags. Full geometry/native work charged. File reads, diagnostic re-audit and lossless archiving reported separately, inside worker wall.
complete_policy_benchmark.reference: New single-policy wrapper follows exact frozen H2bc unified48 dependency chain; BP and extra output-only controls are not evaluated inside this policy timing. Published BP AdamW for these same inputs shown first and clearly archived/descriptive.
complete_policy_benchmark.target: Median of four paired full-cohort legacy_wall_seconds / fast_wall_seconds >=1.1, separately from geometry target. Exact boards/counters/flags and full choices/traces every repetition required.

reporting: Report all four paired ratios, warmup/load/transfer/archive times, useful live GPU/process counters and all failures. Separate support/falsification for the two measured speed targets; no timing confidence interval or universal speed claim. Optimization is not a new fresh accuracy study. Freeze source/hardware/selected-state hashes after gates and before timings.
